referee_caveats_inferred: Filament selection is by visual inspection of one line and is not reproducible without the authors' masks.
The density, and hence the pressure, uses the continuum 5 sigma upper limit and a line-of-sight depth equal to the width, so the turbulent pressure is an upper limit and the geometry is assumed.
One Tex of 70 K and one gas temperature are applied to all molecules and positions, and optically thin LTE is assumed for SiO and others.
The KS comparison uses few molecules and mixes lower limits and non-detections; sample sizes are small.
The shock origin rests on indirect clues; magnetic-field orientation is at 19.6 arcsec, far coarser than the 0.026 pc filaments.
The SiO budget extrapolates a 10-filament sample in 15 pc^2 to the whole CMZ and uses a SiO mass from single-dish data.
